scope: Evidence levels are scoped, not universal guarantees or all-hour service proof

invariants.name: Provenance
invariants.scope: 12 pinned sources independently audited; accepted three-archive service window with 14 durable exclusions; owned wrong/missing source fixtures
invariants.limitation: Full-hour committed source descriptors not yet published

invariants.name: Replay identity
invariants.scope: Owned actual broker/checkpoint retries and sealed-window suppression; exact older-coordinate conflicts rejected

invariants.name: Multiplicity
invariants.scope: 12-source exact union has 4,725,156 distinct IDs; 118,172 repeats preserved; actual cross-archive equal-payload owned fixture
invariants.limitation: Full-hour event-service union not yet accepted

invariants.name: Completeness
invariants.scope: 12 complete source ledgers; accepted fifteen-minute complete-window descriptor; failed initial attempt remained unsealed
invariants.limitation: Full-hour committed window still requires separately authorized service acceptance

invariants.name: Temporal honesty
invariants.scope: Original seconds/microseconds and source precision retained in 12-source independent projection; historical/replay time separated
invariants.limitation: Not physical event latency, operator intent or routing state

invariants.name: Committed visibility
invariants.scope: Actual MinIO missing/corrupt sources, sidecars, physical files and manifests rejected; uncommitted partial outputs excluded
invariants.limitation: Owned fault fixtures; not power-loss/multiwriter durability

invariants.name: History reproduction
invariants.scope: 12-source level-3 exact projection; accepted fifteen-minute level-4 committed service projection and queries
invariants.limitation: Full-hour service history not yet accepted

invariants.name: Error accounting
invariants.scope: All 57 exact framed exclusions audited; 14 committed and verified in accepted three-archive window; isolated absent/conflicting sidecars rejected
invariants.limitation: No full-hour published exclusion/window inventory yet; disposition remains pinned parser policy

invariants.name: Compatibility
invariants.scope: 1023 unit/quality, 80 API, 80 Spark regression tests; original Terraform/RPKI code/layout unchanged
invariants.limitation: Prior external dataset services not reprocessed; owned RIS integration is separate
